parts.instructions: You are a new member of the club. Fill in the form. Write in sentences. Use 20-30 words.
parts.prompt:
Tell me about the last time you watched a good movie.
The last time I watched a good movie was 2 weeks ago, the movie was "3 thousand years of longing". It is a very good movie with well-made special effects and a plot. It taught me a lot of lessons about love and maturity so I like it a lot

parts.instructions: You are communicating with other members of the club in the chat room. Reply to their questions. Write in sentences. Use 30-40 words per answer.

chatMessages.messageText: Watch a movie at night and often fall asleep when the movie is half shown. Please give me some experience.

I think it depends on your choice of movie. I also once fell asleep during a romance movie. But I never do when I choose a thriller or an action film. So choose a blockbuster and make the best of your relaxing time
Do you prefer watching foreign movies or movies in your mother tongue? Why?

parts.instructions: You are a member of the club. Read the notice from the club president/manager and write the requested emails.
parts.managerNotice:
Dear Members,
Our club will invite a famous film critic next week, and what is the topic should he talk about and how to attract many people as possible to attend
Email 1 : Email to your friend
Hi Rose,
How’s life?
Did you know that the club will invite a famous film critic next week?
I think we choose a captivating topic such as "The Evolution of Cinema: Past, Present, and Future” and promote the event through social media.
What do you think about the issue?
Love,
Jennie.
Email 2 : Email to the club manager
Dear Manager,
My name is Jennie and I have been a club member for 2 months. I am writing this email in response to your latest email about the club’s issue.
According to the news, the club will invite a famous film critic next week.
I would venture some of my suggestions. To attract a large audience for our club's event featuring a famous film critic, choose a captivating topic such as "The Evolution of Cinema: Past, Present, and Future." Promote the event through various channels, use engaging visuals, and emphasize the critic's unique insights and experiences. Offer Q&A sessions or a discussion panel to make it interactive and appealing.
I look forward to hearing from you if my ideas are acceptable
Sincerely,
Jennie.
